decisions.reason: The source specifies the separate power-to-main interboard connectors; it does not change the battery connector's three-pin JST-PH electrical interface.
The candidate already requires JST-PH for power and JST-GH for signals; the detailed pinouts do not alter that sourceability strategy.
Routing SDA0 and SCL0 through the signal connector does not change the established I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The source defines connector families and electrical pinouts but does not change board dimensions, connector form or placement, mounting holes, or enclosure fit.
The source concerns power-to-main interboard connectors and does not change the battery connector's placement, orientation, clearance, or spacing.
Exposing 5V and 5V_EN on the interboard connectors does not change the sensor rail's voltage, GPIO control, converter circuitry, loads, or operating pattern.
